name: RemBrowse page menu
description: Part of RemBrowse: tells RemBrowse when a page leaves a right click to the browser, so RemBrowse can show the page's context menu, and when a link is Ctrl+clicked or middle-clicked, so RemBrowse can open it in a new tab; and copies a picture to the clipboard when a page's own copy button asks for it, which the engine can't do on Android.
